name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 176B NVFP4 + NEXTN (SGLang, concurrency tier)

memory_estimate_mb.notes: Docker cap 110g on a 128 GB unified pool; SGLang mem_fraction 0.85 (cookbook single-Spark cell). Host MemAvailable in service: 19.8 GiB at the concurrency tier (docs/flash-lane.md measurement). The 47.7 GiB FP8 N-gram (PLE) table lives in a sparse NVMe file read through GB10 host page tables (--ple-offload-backend file), with a resident-set budget of 8 GiB (SGLANG_QWEN4_PLE_FILE_RSS_BUDGET_GB). Boot to /health: 12 min 21 s fresh PLE table, 14 min 54 s when it rewrote a populated one. KV pool lottery is real on this lane: 189,056 vs 249,408 tokens for the same launcher two boots apart (2026-09-03); the launcher's MemAvailable>=96 GiB floor loop bounds it.

drafter.notes: MTP head rides in the target checkpoint (in-checkpoint MTP tensors are BF16 in this NVFP4 export, hence unquant). Reduced draft vocabulary (--speculative-token-map, 65,536 rows) is generated per box by install.sh; worth 14-25% decode, value-bearing flag rendered by the tier.

ports.notes: Hasso box default PORT=30000, keepalive proxy PORT+1; per-box choice (host placeholder upstream). Live 1c2c serves the engine on 8080 behind keepalive/guard proxy 8081 — do not treat 30000 as the running port.

ple.requiresAts: GB10 ATS addressing mode (iommu.passthrough=0); outside it the engine refuses the table at weight load (upstream issue #54) — checked by a preflight that exits 78.

multi_spark.rule: copy-on-tp-or-machine-change: this file is tp=1 on dgx-spark-gb10-128g. This component exists precisely because the 176B checkpoint fits ONE GB10 via file-backed PLE + GB10 host-page-table access; that mechanism is GB10-specific, so a 64 GB Spark or a TP2 pair is NOT a copy-and-run — a copy must re-prove the PLE path or pick another export (e.g. the vLLM FP4-Local lane), with its own measured flags and estimates.

description: Flash lane, RadixArk target: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (176B hybrid MoE, 6B active) NVFP4 with in-checkpoint NEXTN, SGLang nightly on one GB10, concurrency tier (8 running requests). Converted from Hasso's builtin recipe 'flash'; image/model pins and tier flags verbatim from upstream at the commit above. Dashboard install/switch uses pinned alzeo interfaces. Quoted speed figures are upstream claims, not an acceptance gate.

notes: Upstream tok/s (47.9 code, 47.1 math, 29-31 prose, 27.0 ms/tok agent loop at context tier) are alzeo README citations, not local SLAs.
Flash boot writes the 47.7 GiB PLE table every time: ~12-15 minutes to /health.
Lanes are mutually exclusive with the 27B stock unit on 8080/8081.
Flash target ~248 GB HF cache + ~53 GB image when both disks are one volume (~301 GB).

confirm runs MODEL_CHOICE-scoped ./install.sh --no-start after the git pin is verified (install vs launch are separate). Upstream install.sh has no --yes; it uses sudo -n then sudo -v (TTY required) — dashboard preflight requires sudo -n.
